Opposite dx is a single bbox-only diagnostic. No alpha, actual RGB change, target identity or front-depth proof is added; no new supported pair or labels/admission.
Existing6 weak-UNKNOWN cases remain UNKNOWN. All failures/U and native0..7 denominators retained; missing real material/aspect/factors not guessed.
